centre.name: Fraser House Society

about_blocks.text: Fraser House Society, which was founded on October 13, 1967, initially operated as an in-patient addiction treatment program for male patients. However, in 1987, the society shifted its operations and started providing non-residential counseling and prevention services to the residents of Mission and the surrounding areas for anyone experiencing substance-use-related challenges, including youths and adults. The society aims to promote the development and implementation of effective prevention and counseling strategies to create a healthy community. Fraser House Society employs bio-psycho-social-spiritual and harm reduction approaches in its programs, aiming to serve clients at their personalized levels without imposing any particular treatment or recovery model.

about_blocks.text: Fraser House Society is a rehabilitation centre dedicated to providing comprehensive support to those who have been affected negatively by alcohol and drug use. The centre offers a range of individual, group, and family therapies to help those on their road to recovery. Those who wish to access the centre will find warm and welcoming staff who are committed to creating a supportive environment for each person who walks through the door. Additionally, Fraser House Society offers educational resources and community awareness initiatives to help build awareness around common issues related to alcohol and drug use. The centre’s hours of operation, from 8:30 am to 12 noon and 1 pm to 4:30 pm Monday to Friday, ensure that clients can access the support they need at a time that suits them best.

about_blocks.text: What sets Fraser House Society apart is the range of specialized treatments it provides to those recovering from substance abuse issues. Clients have access to both traditional and holistic therapies, tailored to each individual’s needs. These therapies include evidence-based practices, nutritional counselling, art and nature therapy, and yoga and meditation. The centre’s expert staff help clients learn positive coping skills, develop individualized wellness plans, and rebuild their lives through a holistic approach. Whether an individual needs therapy support individually, with their family, or in a group setting, Fraser House Society provides an inclusive and non-judgemental atmosphere designed to support each person along their path to recovery.
